name: .257 Cal-090gr Absolute Hammer™

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "g7-bc= .177"; the method is not stated.

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "Ok quarter bore guys, we got you the rocket sled ready to run. 1-10″ twist 90gr Absolute Hammer™ is going to be fun for sure. Just think a 257 Weatherby Mag running at 3900fps. I think Roy has a grin right now. Absolute Hammer™s should be loaded with caution as they will not line up with conventional load data." The weight is taken from the product name (090gr).

sources.note: https://hammerbullets.com/product/257-cal-90gr-absolute-hammer/: Recommended minimum twist rate is 1-10″ | Bullet length is 1.05″ | Nose length is .593″ | Recommended use: Big Game Hunting | g7-bc= .177
